errors.generic: Could not sign in with Google. Try again or use email and password.
errors.androidMisconfiguredDescription: Error [28444]: Android OAuth must match how the APK was installed. Debug (Android Studio): SHA-1 from gradlew signingReport. Play Store: App signing key SHA-1 from Play Console. Web SSO client must match Supabase (Synckerja 54m2…). Do not put Android client IDs in .env. Firebase: add both SHA-1s, re-download google-services.json. Then build, cap sync, reinstall.
errors.reauthFailedTitle: Google could not verify the account
errors.reauthFailedDescription: Android reported Account reauth failed (not a cancel). On emulator: use a Google Play image, add a Google account in Settings, update Google Play services, or test on a physical phone. Also verify Android OAuth SHA-1 for this build and that the account is a Test user if the OAuth app is in Testing.
errors.noSession: No active session after Google sign-in. Try again.
errors.notConfigured: Native Google sign-in is not configured. Set VITE_GOOGLE_SSO_WEB_CLIENT_ID (and VITE_GOOGLE_SSO_IOS_CLIENT_ID on iOS) in the app build, and add Android/iOS OAuth clients in Google Cloud.
